plan: The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any bid below your value, you risk losing the item to a slightly lower bid and missing out on a positive profit. For any bid above your value, you risk overpaying and realizing a loss. Given my value is $15, I will bid $15.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you win if and only if your bid is the highest, and you pay the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone who values it more, while bidding more than your value risks paying more than the item is worth to you. Therefore, I will bid my value of $36.

The dominant strategy in this second-price sealed-bid auction is to bid your true value. This is because you want to win if and only if your value exceeds the second-highest bid. Bidding less than your value risks losing the auction to someone with a lower value, while bidding more than your value risks overpaying. My value is $42, so I will bid $42.
